card.name: Modifier word before a study or device noun
card.fires_on: A modifying word or word start that sits right after a hyphenated or descriptive phrase and before the noun it describes, such as study type, device or system.

modes.label: Study descriptors
modes.description: A population or condition word inside a string of trial-design adjectives, just before 'monotherapy' or 'study'.
modes.example: controlled, fixed dose<< pediatric>> monotherapy study, 31%
